bagPolicy.summary: Only bags smaller than 14 × 14 × 6 inches are admitted; backpacks of any size are prohibited. Some events apply a modified policy.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Venue-owned lots have 3,300 spaces. Lots W and E normally open 6 a.m.–2 a.m.; Lot C opens 2.5 hours before a theatre event. West Garage event parking is listed at $40 plus tax, while other pricing varies.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the white zone on eastbound Chick Hearn Court between L.A. Live Way and Georgia Street, or southbound Figueroa Street between 12th Street and Pico Boulevard. Follow posted no-stopping signs elsewhere.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The theatre is cashless, including food and beverage stands, and offers free cash-to-card kiosks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The theatre offers accessible seating and designated accessible parking, and its A-Z guide states all restrooms are wheelchair accessible.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Peacock Theater does not allow re-entry; leaving requires a new ticket to return.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Peacock Theater does not offer will call pickup or accept will call drop off. On event days, the box office opens three hours before the event (sometimes two hours for events starting before noon) and stays open through intermission; it is closed on non-event days. Advance tickets are also sold at the Crypto.com Arena Box Office and delivered by mobile.

gates.summary: Guests undergo metal detector screening, visual checks and bag inspection; check the event page for the door-opening time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
